# instill

> Curate typed library entries and sync project agent state through APM.

`instill` is a Go CLI for selecting project-specific AI coding support from a
typed Library catalog. It writes an APM manifest (`apm.yml`), copies selected
local instructions and prompts into `.apm/`, and delegates install, compile,
lockfile updates, security scanning, and downstream harness rendering to the
external `apm` CLI.

## Module

`github.com/AvogadroSg1/instill`

## Key Concepts

- **Library catalog** — CSV-backed catalog under the configured library root.
  Typed entries live under `skills/`, `mcp/`, `instructions/`, and `prompts/`.
- **Typed library entry** — a skill, MCP server, instruction, or prompt selected
  from the Library catalog.
- **APM manifest** — committed `apm.yml` at the project root. This is the
  durable project contract for selected skill paths and MCP dependencies.
- **Copied local content** — selected instructions and prompts are copied into
  `.apm/instructions/` and `.apm/prompts/`; they are not symlinked.
- **Sync** — `instill sync` runs `apm install` and then `apm compile`, then
  reports selected skill, MCP, instruction, and prompt counts.
- **Legacy migration** — old `skill-manifest.json`, `.claude/skills` symlinks,
  `.agents/skills` symlinks, and `settings.local.json` permission reconciliation
  are migration concerns only. Hidden legacy commands MUST NOT mutate state.

## CLI Commands

```
instill init [--skills name,...] [--force]
    Initialize apm.yml. Launches the unified picker unless --skills is given.

instill pick [--type skill|mcp|instruction|prompt] [name...]
    Add typed entries by name. No args opens the unified picker.

instill pick --type <type> --remove name...
    Remove typed entries by name.

instill sync
    Run apm install and apm compile for the current project.

instill status
    Show selected typed entries and drift against copied .apm content.

instill library scan
    Scan the configured Library catalog and write typed CSV catalogs.

instill library show --type <type> [--filter substring]
    List typed catalog entries.

instill library add --type <type> ...
    Add a typed catalog entry.

instill import old-instill|graft|claude|directory <path>
    Import legacy or external state into the Library catalog and apm.yml.

instill add-hooks
    Add `instill sync` as the Claude Code SessionStart hook.

instill bootstrap
    Ensure the external apm CLI is available.
```

Hidden legacy commands such as `check-skills`, `show-library`, and `categorize`
exist only for migration guidance and MUST NOT mutate project or library state.

## Configuration

| Source | Key |
|--------|-----|
| Env var | `INSTILL_LIBRARY_PATH` |
| File | `~/.config/instill/config.json` -> `library_path` |
| Env fallback | `SKILL_LIBRARY_PATH` for migration compatibility only |
| TTY prompt | written to config file on first run |

## Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | General error |
| 2 | Environment error, including missing APM/bootstrap prerequisites or no TTY |
| 3 | Filesystem error |

## Source Layout

```
main.go                         entry point; calls cli.Execute()
internal/cli/                   Cobra command wiring with commandConfig injection
  root.go                       Execute(), newRootCommand()
  init_project.go               init command
  pick_skills.go                pick command
  sync.go                       sync command
  status.go                     status command
  library.go                    library scan/add/show commands
  import.go                     legacy/external import commands
  add_hooks.go                  add-hooks command
internal/instill/               pure domain logic
  apm_manifest.go               APMManifest, MCPDependency, apm.yml read/write
  apm_runner.go                 external apm/brew command runner
  catalog.go                    typed CSV catalog load/write/scan
  config.go                     ResolveLibraryPath; INSTILL_LIBRARY_PATH precedence
  init_project.go               InitProject; apm.yml initialization
  pick_skills.go                Pick; typed add/remove behavior
  skill_picker.go               RunPickTUI; Bubbletea unified picker
  sync.go                       SyncProject and status orchestration
  import.go                     old instill, graft, Claude, directory importers
  add_hooks.go                  AddHooks; installs instill sync hook
  errors.go                     ExitError; NewExitError(); ExitCode()
  atomic.go                     writeFileAtomic()
```

## Design Notes

- instill owns the curated Library catalog and picker UX.
- APM owns dependency resolution, lockfile updates, security scanning, install,
  compile, and harness rendering.
- Library-only commands MUST NOT bootstrap or invoke APM.
- Project APM commands MUST ensure APM is available before acting.
- All manifest, config, catalog, and settings writes use atomic writes.
- `internal/instill` receives paths and `io.Writer`s explicitly; it must not use
  process-global standard streams.
- New tests and docs SHOULD use `INSTILL_LIBRARY_PATH`. Use `SKILL_LIBRARY_PATH`
  only when testing migration fallback behavior.
